notes.title: Early Access - Patch Notes 08/04/2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41608359/06e2c0229b3d3737404df5a9b19bbe21f10efb01.png[/img]

Hey there, community!

We are happy to introduce our first regular update for Hitori Kakurenbo Online. As promised before, we have dived into community feedback and placed all your ideas on our priority list.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41608359/5a09a885ca07749a7c964e0fac32d4513c45b3dc.png[/img]

[h3]🔪 𝐍𝐞𝐰 𝐅𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐬[/h3]

1. [u]Gamepad compatibility[/u]

You may now utilize a gamepad or controller to play Hitori Kakurenbo Online. We are presently testing this functionality, so certain categories will not work when you have your controller connected!

Due to the strong demand for this feature, we decided to provide an early version so that you may enjoy playing the game without using a keyboard or mouse until we complete it in our upcoming updates!

🎮 Game sections that work with a controller at the moment:

- The entirety of the gameplay
- Main Menu
- Pause Menu

🎮 Game sections that are still a work in progress:

- New Game: Where you are able to host a game
- Lobby: Where you are able to ready up and start a round

Stay tuned for more information about our finalized version for the gamepad compatibility and don't hesitate to provide additional feedback regarding it.

2. [u]Back to lobby feature when the match has been finished
[/u]
Players will now be able to easily return to the lobby after the conclusion of a match. Hence providing easier navigation and reducing the time required to organize a round!

3. [u]Updated Discord banner in the Main Menu[/u]

Our Discord banner has received a fresh paint, being more in line with the theme of the game.

[h3]🔋 𝐎𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐢𝐳𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬[/h3]

1. Improved general performance when being present in the lobby
2. Repositioned Early Access text so it does not overlap the lobby "ACCEPT" button anymore

Thank you for reading today's patch notes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41608359/5a09a885ca07749a7c964e0fac32d4513c45b3dc.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1841150/Hitori_Kakurenbo_Online/

notes.title: Hitori Kakurenbo Online - Early Access OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41608359/c11d5f76e307d39aa07c3e0a7c8a335589bc881e.png[/img]

[i][h2]One, two,... the Doll is coming for you. [/h2][/i]

We are extremely excited to announce to you all that the [b]Early Access[/b] of [b]Hitori Kakurenbo Online[/b] has officially been launched on [b]Steam[/b]!

In addition to this news, the Steam page has received a full overhaul to complement our milestone. Not only that, but we are preparing fresh information for our community regarding the healthy development of the project. You all deserve to know what is happening behind the curtains, so we are here to make that happen.

★ Found a bug? Let us know on Discord or Steam forums!

★ Get ready for upcoming devlogs where we dive into new changes, improvements, and content coming to HKO! 

★ A 🗺️ roadmap that allows our playerbase to follow HKO’s progress.
and much more!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/ZtbsYJqZaN][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41608359/920f8cd86fd14e875ff75e7f2d6260e73f6bfab9.png[/img][/url]

[h3]🔪 1 vs 6 🏃[/h3]

With a custom system that allows up to 6 survivors, you can gather your friends to enjoy the setting together or dive into the action online through our 1v4 matchmaking. It will take more than sheer numbers to escape the dangerous Doll, so tread lightly and remember, keep quiet.

[h3]🩸 Hunt or be Hunted[/h3]

Hitori Kakurenbo Online offers a fresh take on the asymmetrical genre, placing you in exciting player-versus-player rounds that offer both unique and fast-paced scenarios. As the hunted, hide and complete the ritual to escape the cursed grounds unscattered. As the hunter, your priority is to swiftly eliminate all your targets, making sure their curiosity will be their end.

[h3]💡 Use your unique abilities[/h3]

Teenager or Doll, you will be granted various abilities as you face off, but be aware that every teenager has advantages and disadvantages based on their personality. Furthermore, survivors can find valuable items scattered over the map. Experiment with a wide range of strategies as the chasers bring a lot of unique surprises to match the survival elements.

[h3]👔 Customization[/h3]

Customize your characters to your liking, including hundreds of interchangeable parts for the Doll to make it the most oppressive in the eyes of the escapees. Progression is a core part of the game, allowing all players to freely stylize in tandem with numerous content updates.

Community feedback is extremely valuable to us. We read and apply fixes based on the experience of everyone. Don’t hesitate to let us know what you think about our asymmetrical title through our socials.

Thank you for your constant support and see you in-game!!!
❤️ Infinite Thread Games

Check out Hitori Kakurenbo Online here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1841150/Hitori_Kakurenbo_Online/
